reference_prompt: Draft an original Tetherbound Bramblebun creature reference from the supplied established identity image. ONE full-body three-quarter studio view of the same warm brown woodland rabbit: exceptionally tall upright rabbit ears with soft muted pink/brown inner ears, huge deep green eyes, small dark nose, cream muzzle and layered cream chest fur, stout haunches and large rabbit hind paws, small tufted brown/cream tail. Preserve its tan/brown fur and moss-green/ochre leafy bramble mantle with a few small purple buds over the shoulders and back. Make the foliage broad integrated sculpted leaves and short connected buds; do not create floating wisps or thin brittle stem wires. Neutral ready-standing quadruped, not seated: four separate grounded feet, front legs gently extended with readable shoulders and elbows, rear hips raised enough for readable thighs/knees/hocks and distinct large rear paws. Keep friendly rabbit proportions and face; no anatomy borrowed from a dog, no duck, no new horns or armor. Ears fully inside frame with space above tips; tail separate and complete. Clean riggable stylized game anatomy with coherent fur masses and modest fine detail. Entire body on a light-grey studio background, neutral soft lighting. No people, rulers, text, equipment, clothing, particles, red accents, dramatic action or environment.

No physical whisker strands anywhere. Replace the tall thin woody stems above its back with short broad connected sculpted leaf clusters anchored directly into the existing foliage mantle, keeping the same ochre/moss-green leaves and small purple buds. Do not remove the mantle or change character identity. Preserve its huge deep green eyes, brown/tan fur, tall rabbit ears, cream muzzle/chest, tufted tail, exact ready-standing four-legged pose, four grounded paws, proportions, framing, neutral studio lighting and light-gray background. Keep the full ears and tail inside frame. The result is an original clean riggable reference with no floating pieces or brittle narrow tubes.
